name: @nebulactrl/tokens
description: NebulaCtrl's shared design tokens: the motion scale (transitions.dev usage names plus the better-ui exact values), the --dither-* ink, paper and series tokens, and the halftone (the --ambient-* dials, the shared stipple layer and its host classes), consumed as CSS by apps/web and apps/site and as TypeScript by anything that animates in JS.
